# Posit Package Manager snapshot pin for Track A.
# Greppable and diffable independently of the Dockerfile so that a snapshot
# change is unmistakable in a PR diff.
#
# Format: https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/__linux__/<codename>/<YYYY-MM-DD>
# The codename MUST match the base image. rocker/r-ver:4.4.2 is Ubuntu 24.04
# (noble). The Dockerfile asserts this at build time.

PPM_SNAPSHOT=2025-01-15
UBUNTU_CODENAME=noble
R_VERSION=4.4.2
BASE_IMAGE=rocker/r-ver:4.4.2
BASE_DIGEST=sha256:df26749182af64d5263bf64149d51a427b476ed28c4e046997143be3f97fdd7c
